messages:
ana.partnerships: Heads up — final check for marketplace launch day. I pulled together a short runbook for D‑Day staging, press handoff, and partner traffic split: https://docs.redwood/integrations/launch-runbook (section 2 is the press cadence). Can owners confirm?

elena.pr: Got it. Looking at the runbook now. Quick note: embargo lifts at 09:00 PDT. We need partner quotes in the doc by 07:30 PDT so press can clear. I’ll ping the partner comms thread. :white_check_mark:

sam.solutions: For SI onboarding, we finished smoke tests on staging cluster at 10:00 PT yesterday. Can we keep a 30‑min warm window before live traffic hits? Need to verify tenant provisioning webhook under load.

ravi.engops: Warm window sounds good. Plan: cutover staging -> preprod at 08:00 PDT, then preprod -> prod at 09:15 PDT. Rollback gate at 09:30 PDT if error rate > 2%. I’ll publish the cutover orchestration in #eng-oncall 15m before.

mike.pm: For initial traffic split, propose 5% to marketplace listing (partners) for first 20 min, 20% for first 2 hours, then gradual ramp to 100% over 8 hours if metrics look stable. Metrics: 95th latency, error rate, and token cost per 1k. Agree?

elena.pr: 5% first 20 min works. Also we need a staging preview link for journalists — embargoed asset. I’ll coordinate with legal for the embargo note.

lucas.sis: SI partner onboarding checklist posted to the doc. Need an API key mapping table from devex so we can pre-provision SIs with scoped keys.

sam.solutions: @lucas.sis can you add me to the table? I’ll pre-provision for 3 pilot SIs and share keys with secure notes.

ravi.engops: deploy-bot: schedule rollout window 2025-10-03 08:00-09:30 PDT for marketplace bundle v1.2.
deploy-bot: Rollout window scheduled by @ravi.engops for 2025-10-03 08:00-09:30 PDT.

mike.pm: One more: landing page CTA — we need partner badges, region availability note, and a short FAQ. @ana.partnerships can you confirm content owners for the badges?

ana.partnerships: small typo in last message; meant to ping @ana.partnerships :)

ana.partnerships: Owners: creative (Maya) for badges, marketing (Jon) for CTA copy, legal (Priya) for GDPR blurb. I’ll ping them now.

elena.pr: Press list updated — 12 outlets, short embargo brief + staging screenshots. I emailed the staging preview link to the list with access tokens.

sam.solutions: Reminder: verify SSO flow for partner console before 08:45 PDT. I’ll run a last smoke at 08:30.

ravi.engops: Monitoring: will open an incident channel #release-1754321000 and invite oncall + eng leads. Auto alert thresholds set. If anything hits, we cut traffic to 0 and rollback to v1.1 image.

mike.pm: If all green at 11:00 PDT, marketing will start the blog post publish sequence (staggered promo through noon ET). Elena, is PR set for social copy?

elena.pr: Yup — social queue ready pending final screenshots. Will queue posts 1 hour after embargo lift, staggered by region.

lucas.sis: Small ask for partners: confirm support contacts and SLO expectations by 06:00 PDT. We need these to populate the partner listing.

ana.partnerships: tagging partner liaisons to confirm contacts now.

ana.partnerships: Final checklist summary for owners:
- 06:00 PDT: partner contacts, quotes, and SSO keys final
- 07:30 PDT: PR assets and partner quotes in doc
- 08:00 PDT: staging->preprod cutover (ravi)
- 08:30 PDT: SI + SSO final smoke (sam/lucas)
- 09:00 PDT: embargo lift (elena)
- 09:15 PDT: preprod->prod and initial 5% traffic (ravi/mike)
- 09:30 PDT: rollback gate
- 11:00 PDT: marketing blog + ramp decision

ana.partnerships: Anything missing?

mike.pm: Add observability handoff to customer success for ticket triage (Kara).

elena.pr: I’ll loop Kara into the release channel.

sam.solutions: All good from SI side. Will post final smoke results in this thread at 08:35 PDT.

ravi.engops: Copying deployment hooks here. If prod errors spike, traffic -> 0%, rollback to v1.1, and notify legal/PR. Otherwise proceed with ramp.

ana.partnerships: Thanks all — if no objections I’ll mark runbook as final and archive a snapshot. :rocket:
